description: This Java class defines an 'Order' entity for the web admin panel of a sales management system. It includes fields for order details, status, billing, and delivery information, along with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an e-commerce order, including its current status, date, billing, delivery, and detailed order information.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Returns the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date for the order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order.

methods.name: getOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Retrieves comments related to the order history.

methods.name: setOrderHistoryComment
methods.description: Sets comments related to the order history.

methods.name: getOrderStatusList
methods.description: Gets the list of possible order statuses.

methods.name: setOrderStatusList
methods.description: Sets the list of order statuses.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the delivery details associated with the order.

methods.name: setDelivery
methods.description: Assigns delivery details to the order.

methods.name: getBilling
methods.description: Returns billing information associated with the order.

methods.name: setBilling
methods.description: Sets billing information for the order.
